title: Diamond Turning Technician
description:
Job description:

Integrated Talent Strategies (ITS) Need a Diamond Turning Technician to work in Boulder CO area. This position offers a variety of great benefits.


We are presently seeking a Diamond Turning Technician who will operate single-point diamond turning equipment in the production flow of low to high-volume jobs.

Main responsibilities:

  • Working knowledge of geometry and trigonometry
  • Perform mechanical inspections using micrometers, optical comparators, dial indicators, and drop gauges to ensure components meet specifications with diameter, sag, and center thickness
  • Read and interpret complex prints to determine tolerances and specifications
  • Operate and maintain diamond turning equipment for the precision manufacturing of infrared optical lenses and metal mirrors
  • Adjust, understand programming, set up, and operate state-of-the-art lathe equipment
  • Understands the effect of feed rate, depth of cut, spindle speeds and their effect on quality with different materials
  • Responsible for cleaning and visually inspecting diamond-turned optical components, ensuring compliance with ISO and MIL standards for surface quality and dimensional accuracy
  • Inspects, maintains, and handles single-point diamond tools, knowledgeable in tool features, application, and proper use
  • Optical metrology skills, including calibration and operation of interferometers and surface profilometers (e.g., Form Talysurf) for form error and surface roughness inspection of lenses and mirrors

Requirements:
  • High School Diploma or GED preferred.
  • 7+ year's optics diamond turning or equivalent manufacturing experience preferred.
  • Basic Math skills
  • Teamwork – the ability to work effectively and contribute to a team
  • CNC lathe experience is preferred
  • Utilizes good communication and interpersonal skill
  • Knowledge with DiffSys tool path software or similar
  • Familiar with G&M code, modification of tool path, and use call programs as needed
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel and Windows

  • Benefits start day 1: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, PAID Maternity/Paternity leave, Tuition Reimbursement, Long-term and Short-term disability

    Pay Range: $30-$40 per hour, depending on experience.

    Our facility in Boulder, Colorado, has key functions in Research and Development, Operations, Production, and other disciplines. This facility specializes in the manufacturing of ultra-precision optical components, optical thin film coatings, and optical sub-assemblies for demanding applications in lasers, materials processing, instrumentation, life sciences, avionics, and defense.
    This site offers capabilities that include substantial design and engineering resources, comprehensive optical fabrication and coating capabilities, advanced assembly technology, and an extensive in-house metrology lab.

title: Health & Safety Specialist
description:
Job Summary

The Health and Safety Specialist is responsible for promoting and maintaining a safe and compliant work environment within the manufacturing facility. This role develops, implements, and monitors workplace safety programs, ensures compliance with OSHA and company regulations, conducts safety training, investigates incidents, and works closely with employees and management to reduce workplace hazards and prevent injuries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain health and safety policies, procedures, and programs.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and all applicable federal, state, and local safety regulations.
  • Conduct routine safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments throughout the manufacturing plant.
  • Investigate workplace incidents, accidents, and near misses to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Lead safety training sessions for employees, contractors, and supervisors.
  • Maintain accurate records of safety incidents, inspections, training, and compliance documentation.
  • Monitor workplace conditions and recommend improvements to reduce hazards and increase employee safety.
  • Coordinate emergency response procedures, evacuation drills, and safety preparedness activities.
  • Collaborate with supervisors and department managers to promote a strong safety culture.
  • Review machinery, equipment, and processes to ensure safe operating conditions.
  • Manage personal protective equipment (PPE) programs and ensure proper employee usage.
  • Track and report safety performance metrics and recommend continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Science, Industrial Safety, or related field preferred.
  • 2–5 years of health and safety experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of OSHA regulations and workplace safety standards.
  • Experience conducting safety audits, investigations, and training programs.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and safety management software preferred.
  • CPR/First Aid certification preferred.
  • OSHA 30 certification preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to walk through manufacturing areas for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.
  • Ability to wear required PPE in operational environments.
  • Exposure to noise, moving machinery, and varying temperatures in plant environments.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a hands-on HR Generalist to support our fast-paced manufacturing facility. In this role, you will be the primary HR point of contact for plant floor operations, balancing daily employee relations with recruitment, onboarding, and compliance. The ideal candidate thrives in an industrial environment and maintains a strong, visible presence on the shop floor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Employee Relations: Serve as a trusted advisor on the floor; resolve grievances, conduct investigations, and coach shift supervisors on policy enforcement.

  • Talent Acquisition: Lead full-cycle recruitment for hourly production staff and skilled trades (maintenance, machinists), partnering with local agencies and tech schools.

  • Compliance & Safety: Partner with EHS to ensure OSHA compliance, manage Workers' Compensation claims, and oversee return-to-work programs.

  • Time & Attendance: Monitor timekeeping systems to ensure accurate tracking of overtime, shift differentials, and attendance policies.

  • Onboarding & Training: Deliver engaging orientation and training programs to improve frontline retention.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of HR experience, with at least 1–2 years in a manufacturing or industrial environment .

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or equivalent experience. PHR/SHRM-CP is a plus.

  • Skills: Strong knowledge of labor laws (FLSA, OSHA), experience with HRIS/timekeeping software, and the ability to occasionally connect with 2nd and 3rd shifts.

Work Environment: This role requires a daily presence on a loud, active manufacturing floor. Candidates must be comfortable wearing standard PPE (steel-toed boots, safety glasses).
